# Template — Government Briefing Request
**Carpenters for Housing Reform Victoria**
Use: Adapt this template for government briefing requests. Replace [PLACEHOLDERS] before sending.

## Subject line template
Briefing request — Residential renovation capability in Victoria — [DEPARTMENT]

## Letter template

Dear [TITLE] [RECIPIENT NAME],

I write on [DATE] to request a brief meeting regarding current work being undertaken by Carpenters for Housing Reform Victoria on residential renovation capability in Victoria. The purpose of this request is to provide a concise overview of the issue being examined, outline a bounded pilot concept, and seek any preliminary guidance on whether the matter warrants further consideration.

The underlying problem concerns a renovation responsibility gap that can arise in complex residential work on existing buildings. Renovation commonly involves concealed conditions, prior alterations, incomplete documentation, deterioration, and progressive discovery during the course of works. These factors can create uncertainty about capability, supervision, handoff points, and the practical limits of different professional roles, with potential implications for consumer protection and project risk.

The proposal presently under development is a limited and evidence-led Residential Renovation Capability (RRC) pilot concept. It is intended to test whether clearer capability recognition, decision boundaries, and escalation triggers could improve outcomes in advanced renovation settings without disturbing existing builder pathways, engineering responsibilities, surveying functions, or licensed trade roles. The work is being framed as a policy option for examination, not as a predetermined reform outcome.

What is being requested at this stage is modest: an opportunity to provide a formal briefing, or otherwise to place the issue before the appropriate area within [DEPARTMENT] for consideration. We would welcome the chance to explain the problem definition, the proposed pilot boundaries, and the issues on which further evidence or consultation may be needed.

For clarity, this initiative does not claim government endorsement, and no representation is made that the Victorian Government has adopted, approved, or supported the proposal.

If convenient, I would be grateful for a 30-minute briefing at a time that suits you or an appropriate departmental contact. Thank you for considering this request.

Yours sincerely,  
[YOUR NAME]
